description: Use when an agent wants to browse, filter, or search prediction-market events across all 12 platforms. Returns paginated events, each with its leading outcome, that outcome's price and the event's 24h volume, plus platform metadata and `pdata_url`; call `get_event` for the markets. Filterable by source (polymarket/kalshi/manifold/myriad/limitless/predict/opinion/gemini/hyperliquid/mnx/seer/xo), categories, countries, status, and full-text search via `search`. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Sortable by `volume_24hr`, `normalized_vol_24hr`, `liquidity`, `end_date`, or `closed_time` (prefix `-` for descending). Cap `page_size` ≤ 50 to keep responses small enough for LLM context windows. Before quoting an event price, check the market's `quote_tier` in `get_event` or `get_market`.

active.description: True keeps open rows, false keeps closed ones. Market lists exclude placeholders and open markets explicitly deactivated by the venue.

closed.description: Filter by `closed` flag (true/false). Open markets are `closed=false`.

countries.description: Comma-separated country names to include (OR). Full English names per the AI categorizer's prompt — e.g. 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'European Union'. No allow-list — misspelled values silently yield zero matches.

country_match.description: How multiple `countries` combine: 'any' (default, OR — tagged with any selected country) or 'all' (AND — tagged with all of them, e.g. both Iran and Israel). Markets carry ≤3 country tags.

created_after.description: Filter to rows whose created_at >= this ISO 8601 datetime (first appearance in pdata's database).

created_before.description: Filter to rows whose created_at <= this ISO 8601 datetime.

ends_after.description: Filter to events whose end_date >= this ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. `2026-06-01T00:00:00Z`).

ends_before.description: Filter to events whose end_date <= this ISO 8601 datetime.

hide_ended.description: If true, hide markets/events whose end_date is in the past (end_date <= now()); rows with no end_date are kept.

hide_price_derivatives.description: If true, exclude events with is_price_derivative=TRUE

include_uncategorized.description: If true, the include clause also matches rows whose categories array is empty/NULL or contains only labels outside the canonical set (synthetic 'Other' bucket).

include_uncountried.description: If true, the include clause also matches rows whose countries array is empty/NULL — country-agnostic markets (synthetic 'No country' bucket).

limit.description: Alias for page_size. Both values must agree.

page_size.description: Items per page (1-200; default 50). If limit is also supplied, it must match.

search.description: English full-text search ignores case and accents. Every word must match a stem in the title, description, tags or categories. Events can match market questions. Use `or`, double quotes for phrases, or `-` to exclude a word. A typo can still match. One- and two-letter terms match whole words. Standalone short queries only match titles or questions.

sort.description: Field name; prefix '-' for descending order (e.g. `-volume_24hr`). Common allowed values: `volume_24hr`, `normalized_vol_24hr`, `liquidity`, `end_date`, `closed_time`, `updated_at`. Markets endpoints additionally accept `probability`, `prob_24h_change`, `spread`. Invalid values return 400.

source.description: Source name(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini, hyperliquid, mnx, seer, xo.

status.description: Comma-separated status list; any of {open, closing-soon, resolved}

view.description: Full rows or lean rows with identifiers, prices, volume, times and links. Read `quote_tier` on market rows before quoting a price. Lean rows show `updated_at` (the legacy write time) only when `changed_at` (the last material change) is absent. `checked_at` is the row census confirmation time when available. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.

volume_24hr_max.description: Maximum 24h trading volume. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.

volume_24hr_min.description: Minimum 24h trading volume. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.

volume_max.description: Maximum lifetime trading volume. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.

volume_min.description: Minimum lifetime trading volume. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.
